cybercrime_gov_in.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
cybercrime_gov_in.purpose: National online portal to report cybercrimes, financial frauds, unauthorized digital transactions, and online harassment, backed by the 1930 national helpline.
cybercrime_gov_in.official_source: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre - I4C)

rbi_cms.name: RBI Complaint Management System (Integrated Ombudsman Scheme)
rbi_cms.purpose: File complaints against banks, NBFCs, or payment system operators for unauthorized debits, delayed reversals, or deficient grievance redressal.
rbi_cms.usage_condition: To be used if the bank or wallet provider does not resolve the complaint or refund unauthorized debits within 30 days.

sanchar_saathi_chakshu.name: Sanchar Saathi - Chakshu (Report Suspected Fraud Communication)
sanchar_saathi_chakshu.purpose: Citizen facility to report suspected fraudulent calls, SMS, and WhatsApp messages received for KYC expiry, utility disconnection, impersonation, or fake lottery.
sanchar_saathi_chakshu.official_source: Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Ministry of Communications

sanchar_saathi_tafcop.name: Sanchar Saathi - TAFCOP (Know Mobile Connections in Your Name)
sanchar_saathi_tafcop.purpose: Allows citizens to check all active mobile SIM connections registered against their Aadhaar or identity documents and report unauthorized numbers.
sanchar_saathi_tafcop.official_source: Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Ministry of Communications

uidai.name: UIDAI (Aadhaar) Official Grievance Portal
uidai.purpose: Lock Aadhaar biometrics, verify authentication history, report Aadhaar misuse, and lodge grievances regarding unauthorized identity use.

sebi_scores.name: SEBI Complaints Redress System (SCORES)
sebi_scores.purpose: File grievances against unauthorized investment schemes, unregistered stock advisors, fraudulent trading platforms, and securities market entities.
sebi_scores.usage_condition: Applicable when fraudulent investment solicitations or trading scams involve securities, stocks, or mutual fund impersonation.
sebi_scores.official_source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

cert_in.name: CERT-In Incident Reporting Portal
cert_in.purpose: Report serious cybersecurity incidents, data breaches, website defacements, malware attacks, and systemic identity leaks.
cert_in.official_source: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

consumer_helpline_ingram.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH - INGRAM)
consumer_helpline_ingram.purpose: Pre-litigation dispute resolution platform to lodge consumer grievances against e-commerce sellers, manufacturers, service providers, and airlines.
consumer_helpline_ingram.official_source: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

edaakhil.name: e-Daakhil Consumer Commission Portal
edaakhil.purpose: Digital filing of formal consumer complaints, replies, and payment of court fees before District, State, and National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions.
edaakhil.usage_condition: To be used for formal legal claims and compensation before the Consumer Commission if informal grievance resolution fails.
edaakhil.official_source: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) / NIC

parivahan.name: Parivahan Sewa Official Portal
parivahan.purpose: Central government transport portal to verify vehicle registration (RC), driving licence status, electronic challans, and download DigiLocker/mParivahan credentials.
parivahan.official_source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

echallan_grievance.name: Parivahan NextGen eChallan Grievance System
echallan_grievance.purpose: Raise official tickets to dispute wrongful e-challans, report camera photo mismatches, incorrect vehicle registration numbers, or technical billing errors.
echallan_grievance.official_source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

vcourts.name: Virtual Courts (e-Courts Project)
vcourts.purpose: View, contest, or pay traffic challans online before a virtual magistrate without requiring physical attendance in court.
vcourts.usage_condition: Available for notified states and traffic jurisdictions when an e-challan has been transferred to court for summary disposal.
vcourts.official_source: e-Committee, Supreme Court of India / Ministry of Law and Justice

samadhan.name: Samadhan Portal (Ministry of Labour and Employment)
samadhan.purpose: Official online conciliation and dispute resolution portal for workers to lodge claims for delayed salary, unpaid wages, illegal deductions, and workplace dues.
samadhan.official_source: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

shram_suvidha.name: Shram Suvidha Portal
shram_suvidha.purpose: Unified labour compliance and grievance redressal platform under the Central Labour Commissioner (CLC) for wage inspections and employer violations.
shram_suvidha.official_source: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

cpgrams.name: CPGRAMS (Centralized Public Grievance Portal)
cpgrams.purpose: Escalate unresolved grievances against central or state government departments, police departments, transport authorities, and public sector undertakings.
cpgrams.usage_condition: To be used when complaints to primary administrative departments or authorities receive no response or corrupt inaction.
cpgrams.official_source: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)

nalsa.name: NALSA (National Legal Services Authority)
nalsa.purpose: Apply for free legal aid, legal representation, and legal advice for eligible citizens, workers, women, and marginalized sections facing civil disputes.

bis_manakonline.name: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS ManakOnline)
bis_manakonline.purpose: Verify hallmark authenticity on gold jewellery (HUID verification), report non-hallmarked jewelry, check ISI mark compliance, and lodge product quality grievances.
bis_manakonline.official_source: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

mca_portal.name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA21)
mca_portal.purpose: Report corporate fraud, unauthorized director filings, fraudulent Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) misuse, and illegal shell company operations.
mca_portal.official_source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India

irdai_bima_bharosa.name: Bima Bharosa - IRDAI Insurance Grievance Redressal System
irdai_bima_bharosa.purpose: Central statutory portal for policyholders to register, escalate, and monitor complaints regarding rejected, delayed, or repudiated health, life, and motor insurance claims.
irdai_bima_bharosa.usage_condition: When an insurance company or TPA repudiates, delays, or arbitrarily deducts a valid insurance claim and fails to resolve it within 15 days.
irdai_bima_bharosa.official_source: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI), Government of India

epfigms_portal.name: EPFiGMS - EPF i-Grievance Management System
epfigms_portal.purpose: Centralized grievance system for Provident Fund subscribers regarding non-deposit of PF by employers, joint declaration attestation disputes, delayed transfers, and UAN corrections.
epfigms_portal.usage_condition: When an employer fails to deposit deducted PF or maliciously refuses to attest joint declarations for KYC/name correction.
epfigms_portal.official_source: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
